### Workflow handoff: urlshort-slice-delegated-b@1 step design_review

Workflow instance: 01M40CPBYR97637QGHT57BNEBY
Prior step: design (design) closed by design-agent@urlshort-factory
This step: design_review (design_review)
Objective: Independent review of design.md (and impact-analysis.md on brownfield slices) against the SPEC: every acceptance criterion reachable, error contract explicit, data model and migration reversible, threat model covering every new entry point, smallest structure that satisfies the SPEC. MUST-FIX or HIGH routes back to design; otherwise the locked set proceeds to plan_lock.

Prior step note: Design candidate d7fa602 for 03-operate against SPEC b53372f. One servlet filter at +2 (after request id and Boot's observation filter; body limit moved to +3), GCRA bucket per client and budget (one long, released when full, sweep on the app Clock), classification on MVC's decoded lookup path, 429 written by the filter in the advice's shape; client = peer or right-most untrusted XFF behind listed proxies (getRemoteAddr not rewritten; A-9 request-wrapper named as the backlog mechanism). Prometheus registry + /actuator/prometheus (resolved online once into the shared .gradle-home, so offline seats build; builder captures OSV), readiness with db, status-only health, Http11Processor at WARN (A-17: Tomcat logged the client's request target), 10 s phase inside a 20 s stop grace, loopback publish, read-only root with tmpfs. Verified on Tomcat: design-probe/output.txt B1-B3, O0-O6b, D1-D2, P1-P10. AC-25 residual stated for the reviewers to judge against the predicate: 0 resets in 10 stops at 100 req/s (three runs), 2-5 per stop at a 3500-5000/s closed loop (~1 ms window). Grants qitem-20261003084948-76a4a31d both conditions met (RateLimitDefaultsTest reads the shipped file; @AfterEach clock reset). ADR-0014..0017, third ADR-0004 amendment, DESIGN.md, container view, ratelimit-sequence. Note: an 11.6 MB probe output sits in history at dca64fb (trimmed to 163 KB at aea4ea3, no rewrite on main). No human decision. 02-analytics rework next.

Continuation: rig workflow project --instance 01M40CPBYR97637QGHT57BNEBY --current-packet qitem-20261003091111-32efdbe2 --exit <handoff|waiting|done|failed> --actor-session review2-agent@urlshort-factory
Context: this workflow packet is a shortcut, not the whole story; inspect additional project, mission, and receipt evidence before choosing an authored exit.
closureTarget: Design review FAIL on d7fa6029168f74ae8b67efa6607dcf7a08296931; report and evidence commit 23f4bf5. DR-01 HIGH: ResourceHandlerUtils WARN logs raw-IP path canary on exempt 404; real-server control with that logger at ERROR suppresses it. DR-02 HIGH: native shutdown reproduced four post-connect resets in each closed-loop cycle, contradicting SPEC AC-25/rule 13 despite ten clean paced cycles. Contract decision routed to lead as qitem-20261003092210-1156d6e8; work DR-01 independently and coordinate any SPEC change with requirements and recorded authority. DR-03 MEDIUM: lazy sweep does not guarantee deletion within 61 wall-clock seconds while idle. Answer all findings in design Review response and hand off revised candidate. Read docs/review/03-operate/design-review.md; no src or tests changed.
